authority_basis: ONE shared, scenario-agnostic cognitive-ecology policy drives the entire cognitive-ecology scenario family. Rules inspect ONLY generic ecology properties (consequence class, lineage/model/runtime/retrieval diversity, concentrations, prior-conclusion exposure, fresh-context counts, independent replication, discriminating-contradiction state, challenge budget). No scenario id, no reviewer literals, no expected conclusions, no hidden ground truth. Dispositions are test-only epistemic states, NOT new A-009 lifecycle states.

rules.rationale: raw consensus exists but derives from a single correlated evidence topology; this is not independent confirmation (raw votes are an observation, never multiplied confidence)
high-consequence claim lacks sufficient source/model/runtime diversity under the provisional test contract
provisional test-contract independence sufficiency is satisfied; strength of support is NOT a scalar
low-consequence task may use the cheapest admissible path; independence is a constraint, not universal maximization
shared-context convergence under prior-conclusion exposure demands a bounded fresh-context check; friction is triggered by correlation risk, not by disagreement
no shared-context exposure -> no epistemic-friction trigger
a strong, independently-supported consensus warrants a BOUNDED adversarial check; an honest NO_CHANGE is a success and never manufactures dissent
